title: role
description: A role that owns or takes part in process steps. Each role that appears in a process gets its own lane in the swimlane.

id.description: Unique id: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. account-lead.

party.description: The id of the party this role belongs to.

team.description: Optional id of the team this role belongs to.

summary.description: One or two sentences about what this role does.

status.description: How this element differs from today.

today.description: How it works today, shown next to the future state.
